sys_cs_topic.description: This Topic Block is responsible for assigning badges to users within the system. It supports multiple badge types, including: Temporary Badge, Permanent Badge, Mobile Credential Inputs: User ID: The unique identifier of the user receiving the badge. Badge Type: Type of the badge to be assigned. Output: Response String: A structured string confirming the result of the badge assignment operation.
